responsibility: This header declares the D runtime entry points that the GCC D frontend calls directly, such as runtime initialization/termination and GC allocation helpers, and provides the small `d_gc_malloc` placement-construction wrapper used to allocate frontend-owned data structures through the D runtime allocator. It is the minimal C++ interface layer between GCC-side frontend code and druntime services.
same_name_distinction: Unlike d-frontend.cc, which implements shared D frontend callbacks into GCC, this file is just the small C++ interface header declaring druntime functions such as rt_init, gc_malloc, and the d_gc_malloc wrapper for frontend code to call.
